title: Alaska News Nightly: Tuesday, August 11, 2026
text:
Tuesday on Alaska News Nightly

Juneau officials say this year's glacial outburst flood is on its way, and just a week out from the statewide primary, a Republican former state lawmaker from the Interior makes his pitch to be governor.

Plus, Juneau's Filipino community celebrates the history and flavor of a traditional dish.

Reports tonight from:

Liz Ruskin and Wesley Early in Anchorage,Alix Soliman, Eric Stone and Elan Chappell in Juneau,Evan Erickson in Bethel,Katherine Rose in Sitkaand Patrick Gilchrist in Fairbanks.

This episode of Alaska News Nightly is hosted by Casey Grove with audio engineering from Crystal Hyde and production by Kirsten Dobroth.
